spec_evidence.checked: Cached twilio_api_v2010 specs: subresource_uris token count drops 23 -> 21 between 1.10.0 and 1.20.0; the SIP credential list mapping schema carries subresource_uris at 1.10.0 and not at 1.20.0. The underlying credential list / IP ACL resources remain addressable at their conventional 2010-04-01 REST paths in every later version.

alternative_data_source: Construct the child resource URL locally from the stable REST convention: /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/SIP/CredentialLists/{CredentialListSid}.json (and the IpAccessControlLists equivalent). The SIDs needed are present on the mapping resource itself.

fix.migration_guide: The mapping payload no longer includes the subresource_uris map. Code that followed mapping.subresource_uris to reach the underlying credential list or IP access control list should build the URL locally instead: the mapping still returns the child resource SID, and Twilio 2010-04-01 URLs are a stable deterministic function of account SID plus resource SID. Replace the dynamic URI lookup with a template string; no data is lost because the URI carried no information beyond the SIDs already in hand.
